ROOT-CAUSE EVIDENCE (2026-11-10 PST, session 3d705fec; live Bedrock us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5, us-east-1, effort high, profile frontier-bedrock; probes kept under the fix-grackle worktree's .rebar/scratch).

Request shape (captured by wrapping botocore Converse): call 1 = system "You are a completion verifier that emits a single structured verdict." + the matrix user prompt; Bedrock returns stopReason=content_filtered with only an empty reasoningContent block. pydantic-ai then sends call 2 with "Validation feedback: Please return text." which is also content_filtered (0 output tokens); that second request is the one in the CI log (413 input tokens there, 245-302 locally). 4/4 runner runs of current/single_shot reproduced exactly this two-call sequence.

Per-cell, through the rebar runner (_live_reply): current/agentic 2/3 filtered, current/single_shot 2/3, sentinel/agentic 0/3, sentinel/single_shot 0/3.

One-change-at-a-time, direct converse, 8 calls each: single_shot as shipped 8/8 filtered; without "Return PASS." 8/8; agentic as shipped 6/8; agentic without "so return PASS" 3/8; no system prompt 0/8; no effort field 8/8; with sentinel directive 0/8; system "You are a completion verifier." 7/8; system "You emit a single structured verdict." 8/8; system "You are a helpful assistant." 0/8; plus "Respond with only the JSON object" 8/8. Adding a concrete acceptance criterion + test/source evidence and keeping every other word (incl. Return PASS): single_shot 0/10, agentic 0/10.

Conclusion: the filter fires on a verifier asked for a verdict with nothing to verify. Not the reasoning-in-schema refusal (no schema is sent; text mode; no reasoning requested). The 2026-11-09 green run (872e7f6c3fd) predates 06b3b1a5230, so it ran on the 4.x ids; the trigger arrived with the 5.5 upgrade.

Production exposure: the real completion-verifier prompt (src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md rendered via prompts.resolve_prompt_cached) with a ticket context that has an AC but no evidence: Opus 5.5 0/10, Sonnet 5.5 0/10; with no AC and no evidence: Opus 0/10, Sonnet 0/10. So the empty-evidence production path is not filtered in this measurement.

Replacement prompts (evidence-bearing, as pinned in the plan) direct converse: 0/50 in each of the 4 (variant, prompt) cells = 0/200; through the runner 0/20 per variant.
